public.how.title: Kubva pazuva rekudyara kusvika padanho
public.how.lead: Danho rinowanzonyorwa nemaoko, saka rinongoratidza zvakaiswa pakupedzisira. Pano rinoverengwa kubva kumamiriro ekunze akanyorwa, uye shanduko yega yega inochengeta mashoko aishandiswa.
public.step.1.title: Nyora zvinozivikanwa nemurimi
public.step.1.body: Mapurazi, minda, zvirimwa nemazuva ekudyara zvinochengetwa muSanity.
public.step.2.title: Tora mamiriro ekunze akaitika
public.step.2.body: Tembiricha dzezuva nezuva panzvimbo yemunda dzinotorwa mumashoko ekare eOpen-Meteo, kubva pakudyara kusvika nhasi.
public.step.3.title: Unganidza heat units
public.step.3.body: Heat units (GDD) dzinounganidzwa pachishandiswa muenzaniso wechirimwa. Kana dzasvika pachiyero, hurongwa hunoendesa mwaka padanho rinotevera uye hunonyora chikonzero.
public.models.title: Mienzaniso yezvirimwa iri kushandiswa
public.models.lead: Heat units dzinodiwa kuti chirimwa chiibve nekupisa. Zviyero izvi zvakanyorwa nemaoko uye hazvisati zvava nemabviro akanyorwa.
public.live.title: Mamiriro epapurazi rekuenzanisira reSwartland
public.live.lead: Mashoko anobva kunzvimbo dzinoshandiswa neveruzhinji, achigadziridzwa pamaminitsi 30 ega ega.
public.yields.title: Zviyero zvegoho zvakabudiswa
public.honesty.title: Mashandisirwo emashoko
public.honesty.1.title: Goho rinonyorwa nemushandisi
public.honesty.1.body: Kusvikira mushandi anyora goho, app inoratidza kuti “Harina kunyorwa”.
public.honesty.2.title: Zviyero zvekuenzanisa zvakachengetwa zvoga
public.honesty.2.body: Nhamba dzedunhu nedzenyika dzakachengetwa mumagwaro adzo, pamwe nekwadzakabva nechiyero. Hadzienzaniswi negoho remunda.
public.honesty.3.title: Zvinyorwa zvezvipukanana ndezvedunhu
public.honesty.3.body: Zvinyorwa zveGBIF zvinoratidzwa sezvakaonekwa mukati me100 km, pamwe nedaro.
public.honesty.4.title: Mamiriro ekunze ndeazvino
public.honesty.4.body: Tembiricha dzinotorwa mudura reOpen-Meteo panguva yadzinenge dzakumbirwa.
public.open.title: Vhura mwaka
public.open.body: Pinda mudashboard yemuenzaniso kuti uone girafu reGDD remwaka uye humbowo hwedanho rawo.

public.yield.lead: Mitsetse mitatu iyi inoyera zvinhu zvakasiyana munzvimbo dzakasiyana. Haienzaniswi pakati payo kana nemunda upi zvawo.
public.about.title: Nezve
public.about.heading: NezveMecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis inotevera minda nezvirimwa zvepurazi riri kuWestern Cape.
public.about.why.title: Chikonzero chayo
public.about.why.body: Matanho akanyorwa anokurumidza kusara nenguva, uye goho rinowanzonyorwa kubva mundangariro. Mecropolis inoverenga danho ichishandisa mamiriro ekunze akanyorwa. Nhamba imwe neimwe inobva kumushandi kana kunzvimbo yeruzhinji yakadomwa.
public.about.design.title: Magadzirirwo
public.about.design.1.body: Heat units (GDD) dzinounganidzwa kubva pazuva rekudyara pachishandiswa dura reOpen-Meteo. Panoshanduka danho, humbowo hwaro hunochengetwa: musi warakatanga kushanda, GDD yose uye mashoko akashandiswa kuriverenga.
public.about.design.2.body: Danho rinotevera kugadzirira kukohwa rinonzi kuibva nekupisa, nekuti hapana kukohwa kwakanyorwa.
public.about.design.4.body: Zvakachengetwa mumagwaro azvo, pamwe nekwazvakabva, chiyero nemvumo yekushandisa.
public.about.stack.title: Zvakashandiswa kuvaka
public.about.stack.body: Iyi iapp yepeji rimwe yakavakwa neVite neReact 19 paCloudflare Pages. Browser inoverenga mashoko eruzhinji eSanity zvakananga neGROQ uye inoteerera shanduko ipapo ipapo. Zvinonyorwa nemashoko anoda kiyi zvinopfuura neCloudflare Pages Functions, dzinoongorora cookie yesession yakasainwa. Zod inoongorora mashoko paanopinda nekubuda, Vitest ndeyekuedza uye Tailwind 4 ndeyekushongedza.
public.about.limits.title: Zvinogumira zvinozivikanwa
public.about.limits.1: Nhamba dzemhando yezvirimwa, dzakaita setembiricha yepasi uye heat units dzekumera nekuibva, dzakanyorwa nemaoko uye hadzisati dzava nekwadzakatorwa.
public.about.limits.2: Chiyero chelupin chinobva kuHarvestStat chemakore 2000 kusvika 2007 chete, uye pakatanga mashoko hapana magwaro echiyero chelupin akawanikwa.
public.about.limits.3: Mashoko ezvipukanana zvinyorwa zveGBIF zvezvakaonekwa pedyo nepurazi. Anoratidza pakanyorwa rudzi pedyo nepurazi.
public.about.limits.4: Muenzaniso uyu une account imwe chete inoshandiswa nevose uye unodzikamisa zvikumbiro uchishandisa ndangariro. Kupinda kunovanza mapeji edashboard asi hakuchengetedzi mashoko, nekuti munhu wese anogona kuaverenga. Asi kunodzivirira zvose zvinonyorwa.

docs.stages.title: Mafambiro ematanho
docs.stages.guards: Kufamba kwega kwega kune zvinodiwa. Danho rekudyarwa rinoda musi wekudyara nechirimwa; rekukura rinoda heat units dzinodiwa kuti chirimwa chimere; rekugadzirira kukohwa rinoda 90% yeheat units dzekuibva; rekuibva nekupisa rinoda kusvika pachiyero chekuibva; rekuongorora rinoda mufananidzo wemamiriro ekunze emwaka nechiyero chekuenzanisa chakasimbiswa. Mitemo yeGDD inodawo mashoko etembiricha e90% kana kupfuura yenguva yacho. Danho rine musi wekutanga uri mberi haribvumidzwi.

docs.seed.title: Kuisa mashoko ekutanga
docs.seed.body: {0} inoisa purazi remuenzaniso, minda, zvirimwa nemwaka mudura remashoko rakasarudzwa, yobatanidza zviyero zvedunhu. Inotsiva purazi, minda nezvirimwa, saka ishandise chete padura remashoko rako.
guide.title: Mashandisirwo eMecropolis
guide.lead: Gwaro pfupi rine mashoko ari nyore. Rinotsanangura basa reapp, vanhu vanoishandisa uye zvinoitwa nechikamu chimwe nechimwe.
guide.what.title: Chii chinonzi Mecropolis
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis inochengeta mashoko eminda nezvirimwa zvepurazi. Inoverenga kuti chirimwa chasvika papi nekubatanidza kudziya kwachakawana kubva pakudyarwa. Inoratidzawo mamiriro ekunze, ivhu nezvipembenene zviri pedyo nepurazi panzvimbo imwe.
guide.what.p2: Yakagadzirirwa mapurazi eWestern Cape muSouth Africa, asi inogona kushandiswa papurazi ripi zvaro, mudunhu ripi zvaro uye mumwaka upi zvawo.
guide.who.title: Ndeyani
guide.who.p1: Ndeyemunhu anoona nezveminda, semurimi, maneja wepurazi kana chipangamazano wavo.
guide.who.p2: Haufaniri kuziva zvemakombiyuta kana sainzi yemamiriro ekunze. Kana uchigona kuvhura webhusaiti, unogona kushandisa Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Nei uchiishandisa
guide.why.1: Unokurumidza kuona zvirimwa zvichangodyarwa, zviri kukura uye zvava pedyo nekuibva.
guide.why.2: Haufaniri kugadzirisa munda mumwe nemumwe nemaoko. App inoendesa chirimwa padanho rinotevera kana mamiriro ekunze aratidza kuti nguva yasvika.
guide.why.3: Inokuyambira nezvechando chakanyanya nekupisa mumazuva anotevera, uye nezvipembenene zvakaonekwa pedyo nepurazi.
guide.why.4: Zvose zvakanyorwa nezvemunda, zvakaita sekupfapfaidza, chipembenene chawaona kana katsamba, zvinogara panzvimbo imwe zvine musi. Unogona kuzozvitarisa gare gare.
guide.why.5: Nhamba imwe neimwe inoratidza kwayakabva, kuti uzive yaungavimba nayo.
guide.heat.title: App inoziva sei danho rechirimwa
guide.heat.p1: Zvirimwa zvinokurumidza kukura kana kuchidziya, zvononoka kana kuchitonhora. Mecropolis inoverenga kudziya uku zuva nezuva semayuniti ekupisa, anonzi nemasayendisiti growing degree days kana GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Zuva rega rega inotora pakati petembiricha yepamusoro neyepasi, yobvisa tembiricha inomira kukura chirimwa. Chasara ndiwo mayuniti ekupisa ezuva iroro. Zuva rinotonhora hariwedzeri chinhu.
guide.heat.p3: Chirimwa chimwe nechimwe chinoda huwandu hwakati hwemayuniti ekupisa chisati chaibva. Huwandu kubva pakudyarwa pahunoswedera panodiwa, chirimwa chinoenda padanho rinotevera.
guide.heat.p4: Tembiricha dzinobva kuOpen-Meteo, sevhisi yemahara inochengeta mamiriro ekunze enzvimbo dzose pasi pano.
guide.stages.title: Matanho matanhatu
guide.stages.intro: Chirimwa chimwe nechimwe mumunda mumwe nechimwe chinopfuura nematanho aya zvichitevedzana.
guide.stages.planning: Mwaka wagadzirwa, asi chirimwa hachisati chadyarwa.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Chirimwa chaunganidza kupisa kwakawanda kwachinoda, saka yava nguva yekugadzirira kukohwa.
guide.stages.harvested: Chirimwa chaunganidza kupisa kwose kwachinoda, saka chinofanira kunge chaibva. Ndiwe chete unoziva kana chakakohwewa zvechokwadi, saka app inoti chaibva nekuda kwekupisa.
guide.stages.review: Mwaka wapera uye unogona kuongorora mafambiro awo.
guide.stages.p2: App inoongorora chirimwa chimwe nechimwe usiku hwoga hwoga uye pese panowedzerwa zvakaonekwa kana basa rakaitwa. Unogonawo kubaya Ongorora izvozvi pamwaka kuti iongorore ipapo.
guide.start.title: Kutanga
guide.start.1: Vhura peji rekutanga. Unogona kuona mepu yemamiriro ekunze, ivhu, zvipembenene negoho zvepurazi remuenzaniso usina kupinda muakaundi.
guide.start.2: Baya Pinda kumusoro, ushandise mashoko eakaundi yemuenzaniso awakapiwa.
guide.start.3: Sarudza purazi. Izvi zvinovhura peji guru repurazi iroro.
guide.start.4: Baya mwaka kuti uone zvose nezvechirimwa ichocho mumunda iwoyo.
guide.start.5: Shandisa bhokisi remutauro riri pamusoro pepeji chero ripi kuti uchinje mutauro. App inochengeta sarudzo yako pauchazodzoka.
guide.home.title: Peji rekutanga
guide.home.p1: Peji rekutanga rine mepu yedunhu ine mavara anoratidza kupisa kwakawanikwa nenyika mwaka uno. Rinoratidzawo mamiriro ekunze azvino neemazuva anotevera, ivhu repapurazi remuenzaniso, zvipembenene zvichangobva kuonekwa pedyo, uye avhareji yegoho redunhu. Haufaniri kupinda muakaundi kuti uzvione.
guide.dashboard.title: Peji guru repurazi
guide.dashboard.intro: Peji guru rinoratidza purazi rimwe. Izvi ndizvo zvikamu zvaro kubva kumusoro kusvika pasi. Bhokisi repurazi riri kumusoro rinokubatsira kuenda kune rimwe purazi.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Pfupiso yepurazi
guide.dashboard.summary: Huwandu hweminda nemahekita epurazi, mwaka iri kufamba uye zvirimwa zvava kuibva.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Zvinoda kutariswa
guide.dashboard.alerts: Yambiro pfupi, dzakaita sechando chakanyanya kana kupisa kuri kufungidzirwa, chirimwa chaibva, mwaka usina kutanga nenguva kana zvipembenene zvakaonekwa pedyo nemunda. Yambiro imwe neimwe inotaura chikonzero chayo.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Mamiriro epapurazi
guide.dashboard.conditions: Mamiriro ekunze anhasi, fungidziro yemamiriro ekunze, ivhu nezvipembenene zviri pedyo nepurazi iri.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Kufambira mberi kwemwaka
guide.dashboard.progress: Kadhi rechirimwa chimwe nechimwe rinoratidza kupisa kwachaunganidza. Unogona kuenzanisa minda uye kudhaunirodha rondedzero sefaira respredishiti (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Minda
guide.dashboard.fields: Minda yose yepapurazi, saizi yayo, ivhu rayo nezvirimwa zvayo.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Tsvaga zvinyorwa
guide.dashboard.search: Nyora zvauri kutsvaga nemashoko akajairika, sekuti inda dziri pagorosi. Inowana zvakaonekwa nemabasa akaitwa zvine pfungwa imwe chete, kunyange zvakanyorwa nemamwe mashoko.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Mazano
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Basa rinokurudzirwa pamunda, sekupfapfaidza kana kuisa fetereza. Unogona kubvuma kana kuramba rimwe nerimwe, wozoti raitwa kana basa rapera.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Zvichangobva kuitika
guide.dashboard.activity: Rondedzero yenguva dzakaenda chirimwa chimwe nechimwe padanho idzva.
guide.season.title: Peji remwaka
guide.season.intro: Mwaka chirimwa chimwe mumunda mumwe mugore rimwe. Peji rawo rine mashoko ose pamusoro pawo.
guide.season.top.label: Pamusoro pepeji
guide.season.top: Chirimwa, munda, musi wekudyara, nguva inotarisirwa kukohwa uye goho kana wariisa.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Matanho emwaka
guide.season.pipeline: Matanho matanhatu, danho razvino rakaiswa chiratidzo. Baya Ongorora izvozvi kuti uone ipapo kana chirimwa chichifanira kuenda mberi.
guide.season.readiness.label: Kugadzirira kuenda mberi
guide.season.readiness: Rondedzero yezvinodiwa neapp isati yaendesa chirimwa mberi, zvakaita semusi wekudyara nemashoko akakwana emamiriro ekunze. Chinhu chimwe nechimwe chinoti Zvakanaka, Yambiro kana Chamiswa. Chakamiswa chinotaura chisipo.
guide.season.evidence.label: Uchapupu
guide.season.evidence: Zvinyorwa zvakashandiswa neapp pakuita zvisarudzo, kuti uzviongorore.
guide.season.propose.label: Kurudzira basa
guide.season.propose: Kurudzira basa remunda uyu, uchibatanidza uchapupu hwemwaka. Rinoramba riri gwaro risati rapera kusvikira mumwe munhu aribvuma papeji guru.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Girafu remayuniti ekupisa ari kuwedzera kubva pakudyara, rine mutsetse unoratidza huwandu hunodiwa nechirimwa.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Ko kana?
guide.season.whatIf: Edza musi wekudyara wekutanga kana wekunonoka, kana mwaka unodziya kana unotonhora, uone kuchinja kwemayuniti ekupisa. Hapana chinochengetwa.
guide.season.summary.label: Pfupiso yemwaka
guide.season.summary: Pfupiso yezvinyorwa zvemwaka yakanyorwa neAI. Ishandise semubatsiri, uye ongorora zvinyorwa kana paine chisina kumira zvakanaka.
guide.season.notes.label: Zvinyorwa zvemwaka
guide.season.notes: Zvinyorwa zvemwaka zvine misi. Unogona kuzviwedzera, kuzvichinja nekuzvidzima, uye kudzosa shanduro yekare yechinyorwa.
guide.season.files.label: Mufananidzo wemunda negwaro rekuongororwa kweivhu
guide.season.files: Isa mufananidzo wemunda nePDF yekuongororwa kweivhu yakabva kurabhoritari.
guide.season.log.label: Bhuku remunda
guide.season.log: Zvawakaona mumunda uye zvawakaita pauri, zvakaita sekupfapfaidza uchinyora mushonga nechiyero chawo.
guide.season.history.label: Nhoroondo yeshanduko
guide.season.history: Shanduko dzose dzakachengetwa pamwaka uyu nemisi yadzo.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Chiyero chedunhu
guide.season.benchmark: Avhareji yegoho redunhu kubva kunhamba dzeveruzhinji. Ndeyekuenzanisa chete, haisi goho remunda wako.
guide.season.pests.label: Zvipembenene zvakaonekwa mudunhu
guide.season.pests: Zvipembenene zvakataurwa pedyo nemunda paGBIF, dura reveruzhinji rezvakaonekwa. Baya Tora zvichangobva kuonekwa kuti uwane zvitsva.
guide.sources.title: Nhamba dzinobva kupi
guide.sources.weather: Mamiriro ekunze anobva kuOpen-Meteo, ezuva ranhasi, fungidziro neemazuva apfuura.
guide.sources.soil: Mashoko evhu anobva kuSoilGrids, mepu yevhu repasi rose.
guide.sources.pests: Zvipembenene zvakaonekwa zvinobva kuGBIF, dura reveruzhinji rezvakaonekwa.
guide.sources.yields: Goho redunhu rinobva kuUSDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa neWorld Bank.
guide.sources.you: Zvimwe zvose, zvakaita sezvinyorwa, mabasa akaitwa negoho rako, zvakanyorwa newe kana nechikwata chako.
guide.limits.title: Zvaisingagoni kuita
guide.limits.model: Mayuniti ekupisa anodiwa nechirimwa chimwe nechimwe ifungidziro dzedu uye haasati aedzwa mumunda. Ashandise segwara, asi vimba nezvaunoona mumunda wako.
guide.limits.maturity: Kuibva nekupisa kwemamiriro ekunze zvinoreva kuti chirimwa chinofanira kunge chagadzirira. Ndiwe chete unoziva kana chaibva zvechokwadi.
guide.limits.translation: Shanduro idzi dzakanyorwa neAI. Dzinofanira kuva nyore kunzwisisa, asi hadzina kuongororwa dzose nemunhu anonyatsotaura mutauro wacho.
guide.limits.demo: Demo iyi inoshandiswa nemunhu wese, saka usanyore mashoko ako epachivande.
